description: Calculates Stamp Duty Land Tax for a property purchase in England or Northern Ireland at current rates, with the band-by-band breakdown, the effective rate, a comparison across first-time buyer, home mover and additional-property (buy-to-let, 5% surcharge) rates, and the total cash needed with the deposit.

buyerType.description: standard for a home mover, first_time for a first-time buyer, additional for a buy-to-let or second home.

depositPercent.description: Deposit as a percentage of price, for the total cash needed figure.

name: calculate_stamp_duty
title: Calculate stamp duty (SDLT)
